map.SameSite 三个取值怎么选？: Which SameSite value should I choose?
map.Strict 完全禁止跨站携带（最安全，但从外链跳回会需要重新登录）；Lax 允: Strict never sends the cookie cross-site (safest, but following an external link back means signing in again); Lax allows it on top-level GET navigations (the recommended default for most cases); None allows it on any cross-site request but requires Secure, otherwise the browser rejects the cookie outright.
map.Cookie 数量和大小有限制吗？: Are there limits on cookie count and size?
map.有限制。多数浏览器限制每个 Cookie 约 4 KB、每个域名约 50 个，总: Yes. Most browsers cap a single cookie at about 4 KB and each domain at roughly 50 cookies, with an overall size limit as well. When you exceed them, older cookies are dropped, which shows up as random session loss. So do not stuff large amounts of data into cookies: store only a session identifier and keep the rest on the server or in localStorage.
